text:
Ashley: Heads-up — planning to push a small Console UI change to canary at 14:00 PT today. Need a quick deploy checklist: CDN invalidation, smoke probes, and rollback tag. Who's taking the deploy?

Derek: I can run the deploy and monitor. Will do canary -> 10% -> ramp if smoke looks good. ETA 14:00 PT.

Maria: I'll run the smoke tests right after canary is live. Quick list I plan to check: login, workspace list, token creation modal, settings save.

Jon: I'll stand by for rollback if anything bad shows up. My rollback branch is ready: `revert/console-ui/2026-03-17`.

Ashley: Thx. Derek — can you fire off the CDN invalidation as part of the deploy? Leave the exact CLI you use here so QA can replicate if needed.

Derek: Yep. Using CloudFront invalidation (dist = E1EXAMPLE). Command I run:
```
aws cloudfront create-invalidation --distribution-id E1EXAMPLE --paths "/console/*" "/static/*"
```
I'll post the invalidation id in thread when created.

ui-oncall: I'll monitor 5xx rate, p50/p95 latency for the console route, and look at any session restore errors. If Sentry sees >5 new errors in 10m ping me and Jon.

deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled by Derek at 1765436400 (14:00 PT). Canary percentage: 10%, monitor window: 8m.

Maria: Quick smoke probe checklist (short):
- open console, sign in as test@redwood.dev
- open workspace, create token
- open billing page (if available)
- check that feature flag X is respected
I'll report pass/fail in 5m after canary finish.

Derek: Invalidation submitted: ID = I3INVALID12345, expected full propagation ~3-5m. Starting canary deploy now (will update again after slot swap).

Ashley: Nice. Reminder: keep rollback plan simple — tag to revert PR and trigger canary back to previous tag. Jon, can you confirm the script to rollback?

Jon: Yup — two steps: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/console-ui -n prod --to-revision=123` (or trigger previous image tag in deploy pipeline). I have the pipeline on standby.

sre-bot: Alert thresholds set: console-5xx > 1% in 5m, latency-p95 > 1.5s in 5m. Will page if hit.

Maria: Canary finished — all smoke checks passed on my side. No new Sentry errors.

Derek: Ramp to 50% now. Will continue to full after another 10m quiet window.

Ashley: Awesome. Leave this thread open for the next hour, and ping if anything odd. :thumbsup:
